Summary of Changes from Previous Version

22/04/2024 – Amendments to clauses 7, 8, and 13, including transition to the new template, approved by Academic Board on 17 April 2024 (AB24/12).


11/12/2023 - Administrative update to title(s), Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Students) and (Education) now referred to as Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Academic).


03/05/2023 - Minor amendments made to clause 4 which were approved by the DVC(S) and Acting DVC(E).


07/09/2021 - The revised policy was approved by Academic Board on 11th August 2021 (AB21/55).
